vitejs/vite-plugin-react#932 (by hi-ogawa): Add example which runs `react-server` conditioned environment with module runner on browser
- this is a variant of `packages/plugin-rsc/examples/no-ssr` and `packages/plugin-rsc/examples/browser-mode` 
- runs `rsc` environment of `packages/plugin-rsc/examples/no-ssr` on browser via module runner like `packages/plugin-rsc/examples/browser-mode/src/framework/load-client-dev.tsx`
- it should be able to use `import rsc from "@vitejs/plugin-rsc"` like `examples/no-ssr`. It shouldn't use `vitePluginRscMinimal` like `browser-mode`.
- add `examples/browser-mode2`

Related https://bsky.app/profile/danabra.mov/post/3m3iei53v3c2k
